artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from severe structural artifacts. The dog's face lacks definition, merging into the body fur (structural collapse). The limbs are poorly defined, with paws melting into the ground/body (fusion). The fur texture is unnaturally smooth and clumped (texture anomaly). While the topology mask was clean, it only confirms the object is a single blob, not that it is anatomically correct. The woman's hands also show minor distortion. These are not subtle errors but fundamental failures in rendering complex biological structures.
